body:
PR-2850 head 52e2858589. main is merged in (no force).
- (1) Blocker: the required checks now come from [review_watch] required_checks, read through review_watch_ready::required_checks (made pub(crate) and re-exported from review_watch). CI_AGGREGATOR_CHECK stays gated, and the dev_autopromote code no longer references it.
- (2) The test the_configured_required_checks_gate_the_promote drives the config-based reader: with the configured aggregator absent the result is MissingRequired, and GitLab may require none. The new test a_github_repo_with_no_configured_required_checks_skips_as_ci_unknown covers an unset, an empty and a malformed list.
- (3) docs/cli/11-dev.md and the guide's dev-build paragraph now name [review_watch] required_checks (today 'Build (ubuntu-latest)').
Gates: cargo check -p aida-cli-lib is clean, the targeted tests pass (39), and make check-ci-fast is green (34 gates).
